title: Summary: the parameters of a sine signal

clips.caption: Three things to keep from this section: <c.aqua>amplitude</c.aqua> sets the height, <c.aqua>frequency</c.aqua> sets the density, <c.aqua>phase</c.aqua> sets where it starts.
The <c.aqua>period</c.aqua> is the reciprocal of the <c.aqua>frequency</c.aqua>, and the <c.aqua>angular frequency</c.aqua> is 2π times the frequency; they describe the same rate of change.
The next section adds, scales, shifts and reverses these <c.aqua>signals</c.aqua>, and watches the combined waveform.
